headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when the AEW TNT Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Wardlow vs. Powerhouse Hobbs battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Wardlow recaptured the TNT Championship from Powerhouse Hobbs with three powerbombs, only to be immediately confronted by a returning Christian Cage and Luchasaurus, setting up his next feud on the spot.
